name: SAGE
description: SAGE (Sentient Agent as a Judge) is an automated evaluation framework that measures large language models' higher-order social cognition by simulating human-like emotional changes and inner thoughts during multi-turn conversations. It provides interpretable emotion trajectories and correlates with psychological empathy metrics.
reputation: New and niche benchmark from a recent arXiv paper; not yet widely adopted as a standard community leaderboard.
notes: Includes a public leaderboard covering 18 models; reveals gaps in social cognition not captured by conventional leaderboards.
